sections.title: Результат
sections.text: SchemaSet SPI, immutable tagged registry, Laravel migration runner, migrate/status commands and testing trait implemented. All 18 schema-owning packages declare 22 current sets. Removed migration publishing/autoload and two SCHEMA_VERSION constants; idempotency migration moved to operations tenant/. Module paths come from SchemaSets::moduleSet; tenancy wave delegates Tenant execution inside its existing advisory-lock transaction. Package docs, errors, exported API, goldens and exact approved BC deltas updated. No baseline DDL reshaping or later P08 item executed.

sections.title: Public contract / BC delta
sections.text: Additive public surface: SchemaSet,SchemaSetStatus,SchemaScope,SchemaLifecycle,SchemaSetProvider,SchemaSets,SchemaMigrator,SchemaSetException,MigratesSchemaSets,DatabaseRegistrar; five closed CoreErrorCode cases and stable ProblemDefinition entries; two Artisan commands. MigrationWaveOrchestrator now requires SchemaMigrator; ProvisioningRegistrar supplies it. Full Roave BC gate passed with finite D111 decision-hash-bound exact descriptions in scripts/bc/approved-deltas.json; no BC policy/base weakening. Existing prior tenancy approved descriptions preserved. php-api manifests, docs/reference/public-api.md and Golden snapshots regenerated with D111 rebaseline entry.
